title.narrative: Preparing the women and childbirth room at Al-Makassed Hospital in Beirut, Lebanon

description.narrative: Providing life-saving medical equipment in the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department, in addition to maintaining these departments, which will provide a distinguished and important health service with high quality.

The project aims to provide life-saving medical equipment in the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department, in addition to maintaining the department in the capital Beirut, Lebanon. The weak government funding has made health facilities suffer from a significant weakness in infrastructure due to the lack of maintenance and weak government funding. The project is considered one of the most important projects due to its effective role in alleviating the suffering of citizens in the city of Beirut by providing medical equipment in the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department and adding an operating room to the department. This will contribute effectively to reducing the deaths of pregnant women and girls, in addition to the maintenance of this department, which will provide a distinguished and important health service with high quality.

This project will contribute effectively to alleviating the suffering of Lebanese citizens affected by the war by providing medical equipment in the gynecology and obstetrics department and adding an operating room to the department. This will contribute effectively to reducing the deaths of pregnant women and girls. In addition, the maintenance of this department will provide a distinguished and important health service with high quality.
